name: text
label: Post Text
help: Tweet text (up to 280 characters for standard posts). Required unless posting media-only.

name: media_file_name
label: Media File Name
help: Filename with extension (e.g. photo.jpg, clip.mp4, animation.gif).

name: media_url
label: Media URL
help: Direct public URL to image or video (e.g. Supabase storage). Recommended for videos — backend downloads server-side.

name: media_data
label: Media Data
help: Image, GIF, or video file from a previous module. Alternatively use Media URL.

name: mediaType
label: Media Type
help: Hint for the upload pipeline when attaching media.

name: replyToTweetId
label: Reply To Post ID
help: Optional post ID to reply to.
